shelfCardHtml: • Fact Matcher Everyone submits a secret fact, the team guesses who's who. Icebreakers, fixed. collect facts →
apiSummary:
Tool module type "fact", VIA key "fact". All endpoints POST, all SQL parameterised via .bind(), all server-rendered user text esc()'d and inline-script values passed through JSON.stringify. Uses the participants table seeded one-per-name (name stored non-blank; the partial UNIQUE(instance_id,name) index enforces one row per person and makes the claim race-safe). Instance data: {prompt<=140 (default "Share a fun fact about yourself"), note<=300, revealed:false}.

Endpoints:
- POST /api/fact {title<=80, prompt?, note?, names[]} -> createInstance(toolType "fact", nouns hunch/alibi/reveal/riddle/tell/guesswork/mixer/icebreak/whodunit/shuffle); batch-inserts one participant row per name (token=randomString(22), data {fact:""}); logEvent "created"; returns {slug, editToken} 201. Names validated: 3..60 of them, each trimmed <=40, non-empty, unique case-insensitively (dupe error names the offender).
- POST /api/fact/submit {slug, name} -> race-safe single UPDATE participants SET claimed_at=? WHERE instance_id=? AND name=? AND claimed_at IS NULL RETURNING token. Win -> {token}. No win + name exists -> 409 {error:"That name's already been taken. If it's you, ask the organiser to reset it."}. Otherwise -> 404 {error:"That name isn't on this list."}.
- POST /api/fact/p/:ptoken/save {fact<=280} -> writes data.fact for that participant; 404 on unknown token.
- POST /api/fact/:etoken/reset {name} -> rotates the row's token to a fresh randomString(22) and NULLs claimed_at/viewed_at (fact kept) so the right person can re-claim; 404 if name not on list.
- POST /api/fact/:etoken/reveal {revealed:bool} -> flips data.revealed via updateInstanceData; logs "revealed" when turning on; toggles the shared page between the join grid and the answer key.
- POST /api/fact/:etoken/delete -> deleteInstance + logEvent "deleted".

Pages (all noindex/no-store via lib html()):
- publicPage /s/:slug: if not revealed, the collection view (name grid to claim -> POST submit -> stores token in localStorage "bbb:fact:"+slug -> redirect /p/:token; claimed names render as non-clickable "submitted ✓" or "joined"; a saved-token banner offers "open your card" plus a "claim again" escape that clears localStorage — no stale-token trap). If revealed, the answer key: every submitted fact in a stable shuffled order (sorted by FNV hash of the row token — deterministic, no Math.random) with the name attached. Guests cannot see any fact before reveal.
- participantPage /p/:token: sets viewed_at on first view; shows the prompt big, a textarea prefilled with their current fact, a Save button (POST save, "Saved ✓"), and the reassurance that only the organiser sees it until reveal.
- editPage /e/:token: organiser banner, share box + shareNudge (via /via/fact footer), status table (name / joined / fact-in / per-row Reset with confirm), submitted count, the shuffled facts numbered for reading out (names appear only once revealed — numbering is stable across reveal), a "Reveal the answers" toggle (confirm on reveal-on), and Delete (confirm).
manualTestPlan: Create: on /fact-matcher/ enter a title, tweak the prompt, add 5 names (one per line) and submit -> lands on /e/<editToken>; status table shows all 5 names, 0 joined, 0 facts in.

Validation: try 2 names -> inline error 'at least three names'; add a duplicate name (case-insensitive) -> live status and submit both warn naming the dupe; paste 61 names -> 'Sixty names is the limit'.
Join: open the shared /s/<slug> link in another browser, tap a name, confirm -> redirected to /p/<token>, localStorage bbb:fact:<slug> set. Collection grid now shows that name as 'joined'.
Submit a fact: on /p/<token> type a fact, Save -> 'Saved ✓'; reload -> textarea still prefilled. Shared page now shows that name 'submitted ✓'.
Stale-token escape: back on /s/<slug> the banner 'You're in — open your card' shows with a working link; click 'claim again' -> localStorage cleared, grid re-enabled, can claim a different name.
Race safety: have two tabs tap the same unclaimed name near-simultaneously -> exactly one gets a /p/ link, the other gets 409 'already been taken'.
Reset: on /e/, click Reset next to a joined name -> confirm -> old /p/ link 404s/participant can't save, name becomes claimable again on the shared page, and their fact is retained after re-claim.

Reveal: on /e/, note the numbered facts read-out (no names). Click 'Reveal the answers' -> confirm -> editPage shows names on the same numbered items; /s/<slug> now shows the answer key (facts + names) instead of the join grid; numbering matches. Click 'Hide the answers again' -> shared page returns to the join grid.
Delete: click Delete -> confirm -> redirected to /fact-matcher/; /s/<slug>, /e/<token>, /p/<token> all 404.

Mobile 375px: builder columns stack, name grid single-column-friendly, answer key and status table do not cause body horizontal scroll (status table scrolls inside .status-wrap). Print /e/ or revealed /s/ -> answer key cards render cleanly.
SEO: /fact-matcher/ has canonical https://bitibybit.com/fact-matcher/, og:image /art/og-fact.png, WebApplication + FAQPage JSON-LD; page works above the fold.
notes:
SHELF PLACEMENT: I put Fact Matcher under a "Community & work" grouping (office icebreaker / onboarding / offsites), leaving the Volunteer Roster in "Food & parties" (canteen/fete/sausage sizzle is squarely food-and-parties). The shelfCardHtml is the paste-ready live <li> replacing the existing Fact Matcher soon-card. If you'd rather not add a new "Community & work" <h2> section, the card also fits fine in the existing "Food & parties" group where the soon-card currently lives — either works; just replace the soon-card <li> with the provided one. Icon /icons/bubbles.png already exists (the soon-card uses it) — no new icon needed.

TWO REQUIRED worker.js edits beyond the standard import/registry (there's no structured field for these):
1) VIA map — add the referral key so the "made with bitibybit.com" footer (which links to /via/fact on every fact page) redirects and logs. In the VIA object add:
     fact: "/fact-matcher/",
2) CREATE_RE rate-limit regex — a fact create is a write amplifier (up to 60 participant rows in one batch), so it must get the tight per-IP create budget, not the loose act budget. Change:
     const CREATE_RE = /^\/api\/(sweeps|kringle|roles|plate|bracket|card|registry)$/;
   to include fact:
     const CREATE_RE = /^\/api\/(sweeps|kringle|roles|plate|bracket|card|registry|fact)$/;

Standard integration: add `import fact from "./tools/fact.js";` with the other tool imports, and append `fact` to `const TOOLS = [sweep, kringle, roles, plate, bracket, card, registry];`. cssAdditions append to the end of public/styles.css. sitemapUrls add the one <loc> to public/sitemap.xml.

VERIFICATION DONE: node --check passed on src/tools/fact.js, public/fact.js, scripts/art-fact.mjs. Ran `node scripts/art-fact.mjs` -> wrote public/art/fact-hero.png (1120x320) and public/art/og-fact.png (1200x630); both visually inspected (line-up of pixel people with varied skin/hair/shirt tones, middle figure in a domino mask, three question-mark speech bubbles, wordmark blocks + BITIBYBIT.COM bottom-left; og carries the FACT MATCHER title + SECRET FACTS - GUESS WHO subtitle). API route regexes self-tested; /via/fact accepted by the worker route pattern. Did NOT run wrangler/servers/git per instructions.

DESIGN NOTES: Closest template was kringle (participants seeded one-per-name, private /p/ tokens, claim-your-name, organiser status table, reset that rotates the token). Reused generic families: .status-table/.status-wrap (organiser table), .share-box, share nudge, .btn/.field/.pixel-note/.organiser-banner/.organiser-actions/.page-foot/.form-error. Added a self-contained .fact-* namespace (grid, banner, prompt, answer key). Stable quiz order is derived from an FNV-1a hash of each row's random token (deterministic, no Math.random, and doesn't leak the organiser's typed name order); the read-out is numbered with CSS counters so a fact keeps its number when you flip to the reveal. Security: every user string esc()'d in HTML; slug/edit_token/participant token passed to inline scripts only via JSON.stringify; all SQL parameterised; secret /p/ and /e/ tokens gate their own instance only; reset rotates the token so lost/wrong-claimed links die.
